steps.command: sed -i 's|security.debian.org|deb.debian.org/debian-security|g' /etc/apt/sources.list && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libfreetype6-dev libpng-dev libjpeg-dev zlib1g-dev libflann-dev python3-dev && pip install --no-cache-dir matplotlib==3.0 && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
